segments.name: TTS
segments.description: Truckload transportation of general commodities for customers via dedicated and one-way fleets across the United States, Canada and Mexico.
segments.evidence: Our TTS segment is comprised of Dedicated and One-Way Truckload.

segments.name: Werner Logistics
segments.description: Non-asset-based transportation and logistics provider offering brokerage, freight management, intermodal and final mile services throughout North America.
segments.evidence: Our Werner Logistics segment is a non-asset-based transportation and logistics provider.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay per-mile rates for truckload shipments plus stop, loading/unloading, detention and repositioning charges and fuel surcharges, while logistics customers pay for brokerage, freight management, intermodal and final mile services.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues for the operating segments (Dedicated and One-Way Truckload) within our TTS reportable segment are typically generated on a per-mile basis and also include revenues such as stop charges, loading and unloading charges, equipment detention charges and equipment repositioning charges.

changes.text: In 2026, the company acquired FirstFleet, a dedicated truckload carrier, whose revenues will be reported in Dedicated within the TTS segment.
changes.evidence: On January 27, 2026, we acquired 100% of the equity interests in First Enterprises, Inc., doing business as FirstFleet, Inc. ("FirstFleet").
